results.description:
Scallop is building the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

We operate at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets, delivering regulated, scalable solutions for individuals, businesses, and enterprise partners.

Our mission is to unify fiat and digital assets into one seamless financial experience.

Scallop provides an integrated financial platform combining multi-currency accounts, real-time FX, and global payment rails within a single ecosystem. Through the Scallop App, users can hold, send, swap, and spend across currencies and digital assets from one unified balance.

For businesses, Scallop offers Banking-as-a-Service and embedded finance infrastructure. Our platform enables fintechs, enterprises, and Web3 companies to launch compliant financial products efficiently and at scale.

Our capabilities include:

• Multi-currency fiat accounts
• Digital asset wallets with on-chain functionality
• Physical and virtual debit cards
• Real-time conversion between fiat and digital assets
• Cross-border payment infrastructure
• Embedded finance and white-label solutions
• BaaS APIs for global partners

Built for a regulated future, Scallop operates with a compliance-first approach across multiple jurisdictions, enabling secure and reliable access to global financial services.

Scallop is not another neobank.
It is a unified financial ecosystem designed for global money movement.
results.tagline: Banking Beyond Borders, Spend, Send and Save
